scientific_integrity: Analytic induction proves all infinite assertions. Finite exact-arithmetic checks test only selected instances. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem holds on a rigorously constructed open large-amplitude chamber, not on every escaping orbit. Equality walls are established as nonempty continuous level sets without a manifold regularity assertion; historical publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Two escape clocks and two sharp projective phase walls in a three-dimensional quadratic Hénon map
